top_10_interactions.name: fast curve progress x entity-adjusted distributed demand
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: Rapid state acquisition is strongest when it is not merely one hidden entity splitting wallets.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: Fast curve progress plus growing independent entities beats either speed or low raw concentration alone.
top_10_interactions.falsifier: No prospective lift over checkpoint/state and raw-flow baselines.

top_10_interactions.name: gross-flow acceleration x unique-buyer acceleration
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: Capital and participation breadth should accelerate together in an organic impulse.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: Positive value acceleration with positive independent-buyer acceleration has lower reversal risk than value acceleration alone.

top_10_interactions.name: first-buyer share x entity concentration x follow-through
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: Low first-print share is credible only if later flow is entity-diverse and the first wallet does not retain cumulative control.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: The N3000-style low-first-share thesis is strongest under low entity HHI and positive new-buyer growth.
top_10_interactions.falsifier: First-buyer share adds no out-of-sample value after entity HHI and curve path.

top_10_interactions.name: creator-linked flow x creator dump history x live first-sell latency
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: Insider seeding is most hazardous when the same entity has a history of fast exits and selling begins now.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: The combined state predicts downside concentration more strongly than generic sellPressure.
top_10_interactions.falsifier: No lift after total concentration and sell-flow controls.

top_10_interactions.name: wallet quality x flow share x history coverage
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: Skilled-trader presence matters only when it represents material flow and cache coverage is known.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: Quality-weighted flow with high coverage improves calibration over binary recurrentWalletShareBps.
top_10_interactions.falsifier: Lift disappears under strict as-of cross-fitting.

top_10_interactions.name: common funder x co-fire x atomic coordination
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: Independent graph, history, and transaction evidence jointly strengthen a coordinated-entity inference.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: Multi-view agreement predicts hidden concentration better than any single heuristic.
top_10_interactions.falsifier: False-positive rate remains high on known shared-service-funded cohorts.

top_10_interactions.name: holder concentration x cluster adjustment x non-trade transfers
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: Risk is highest when current inventory is concentrated, clustering raises it further, or tokens are being distributed outside trades.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: The joint inventory state outperforms gross buy-flow HHI for early dump hazard.
top_10_interactions.falsifier: Transfer-complete prospective data show no incremental relation.

top_10_interactions.name: route urgency x network auction regime
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: A raw priority fee or tip is meaningful only relative to current congestion, route, and leader environment.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: Relative urgency distinguishes informed/competitive entry from client defaults.
top_10_interactions.falsifier: Effects are entirely route-client fixed effects and do not generalize across epochs.

top_10_interactions.name: token relative strength x platform breadth/congestion
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: The same absolute impulse is more exceptional in a quiet market and may be more executable in a healthy feed/network regime.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: Causal percentile features stabilize thresholds across market regimes.
top_10_interactions.falsifier: Raw metrics remain better calibrated across prospective regimes.

top_10_interactions.name: metadata reuse x serial creator x recurring cohort
top_10_interactions.economic_interpretation: Reused assets, repeated launching, and the same early wallets together identify a launch factory more reliably than metadata alone.
top_10_interactions.hypothesis: The interaction improves risk discrimination without an external social call.
top_10_interactions.falsifier: It only proxies a benign launchpad/tooling template.
